messages.context: Rabbit Sis 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: §fThey call me a troublemaker, a rebel. I say, I'm the only one talking sense!
messages.text: They call me a troublemaker, a rebel. I say, I'm the only one talking sense!
messages.zh: 他们说我是麻烦精、叛逆者。要我说,全家只有我讲道理!

messages.context: Rabbit Sis 运行时实测台词
messages.raw: §fWake up and smell the exploitation, family!
messages.text: Wake up and smell the exploitation, family!
messages.zh: 家人们,醒醒吧,闻闻这剥削的味道!

messages.raw: §fChocolate is love, chocolate is life. §f§oBut at what cost?
messages.text: Chocolate is love, chocolate is life. But at what cost?

segments.text: Chocolate is love, chocolate is life.
segments.zh: 巧克力就是爱,巧克力就是生命。

messages.zh: 巧克力就是爱,巧克力就是生命。可代价呢?

messages.raw: §fIt's time this family faces the music and listens to the cocoa beans' side of the story!
messages.text: It's time this family faces the music and listens to the cocoa beans' side of the story!
messages.zh: 这个家也该面对现实了,听听可可豆怎么说吧!

messages.raw: §fBro's always talking about his 'sigma grindset'. Tried to get me to read a book on it.
messages.text: Bro's always talking about his 'sigma grindset'. Tried to get me to read a book on it.
messages.zh: Bro 整天把他的“独狼奋斗心态”挂在嘴边,还想塞本书让我看。

messages.raw: §fI told him I'd start my own movement: the 'chocolate mindfulness mindset'.
messages.text: I told him I'd start my own movement: the 'chocolate mindfulness mindset'.
messages.zh: 我跟他说,我要自创一派:“巧克力正念心态”。

messages.raw: §fI told §aHoppity §fwe should have a line of eco-friendly chocolates.
messages.text: I told Hoppity we should have a line of eco-friendly chocolates.

segments.text: we should have a line of eco-friendly chocolates.
segments.zh: 提议,咱们该出个环保巧克力系列。

messages.zh: 我跟 Hoppity 提议,咱们该出个环保巧克力系列。

messages.raw: §fHe asked if green food coloring counted.
messages.text: He asked if green food coloring counted.
messages.zh: 他问我,加绿色食用色素算不算。
